final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT bp.player_id AS pid, p.bats AS bats, AVG(bp."double") AS avgd FROM batting_postseason bp JOIN player p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id WHERE p.bats <> '' GROUP BY bp.player_id, p.bats), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avgd) AS a FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.pid AS pid, s1.bats AS bats, s1.avgd AS avgd, s1.avgd / s2.a AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT bats, AVG(ratio) AS avgr FROM s3 GROUP BY bats) SELECT s3.pid, s3.bats, s3.avgd, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avgr AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s3.bats = s4.bats ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
